digest.component_or_area: CLI commands (edit, claim) with plan-review integration
propositions: The --review flag on edit must parse as a valueless flag without consuming the next token, then invoke review_plan after the EDIT event commits and map the verdict to exit codes 0/1/2/11 per ADR 0040

The --review flag on claim must sense plan-review gate applicability via a shared helper, call claim_gate_check, and proceed to claim only if the gate applies and the check reports ok; otherwise print the review finding and exit with the mapped disposition code
Both flags must obtain _disposition_exit_code via lazy in-function import from src/rebar/_cli/_llm_commands.py following the established pattern used by other _commands modules
When review_plan raises an exception (provider outage or config error), the exception must propagate through the standard CLI error handler with the edit still committed and claim never invoked

The store lock must not be held during the multi-minute LLM review phase; the edit/claim appends its event under a short-lived lock, releases it, then invokes review_plan which takes the lock only for a brief re-check at signing

Help text must document non-atomicity against concurrent reconvergence and reference review-plan --status; docs/cli-reference.md and docs/exit-codes.md must be updated to reflect the new flags and their exit codes
